decision_conditions: The proposed single storey rear extension, by reason of its depth, height and proximity to the shared boundary, would result in an unacceptable loss of light, outlook and a heightened sense of enclosure to No. 11 Rydal Way contrary to Policies DP3 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD8 and DMD11 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed development in the absence of an adequate flood risk assessment fails to demonstrate how proposed measures manage the risk of flooding, contrary to Policies F7 and F8 National Planning Policy Framework (2026), SI 12 and SI 13 of the London Plan (2021), CP28 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD60, DMD61 and DMD62 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and Enfield Strategic Flood Risk Assessment (2021).
description: Single storey rear extension with raised patio, rear dormer, front rooflights and internal alterations with changes to front elevation.
